what_it_publishes: Generation and consumption by category for the DE-LU bidding zone
what_was_queried: Generation filter set 1223, 1224, 1225, 1226, 1227, 1228, 4066, 4067, 4068, 4069, 4070, 4071; consumption set 410, 4359, 4387; plus a probe of undocumented IDs 4072-4076 and 5000-5009
what_it_returned: The only storage category in either set is Pumpspeicher, pumped hydro, filter 4070 on the generation side and 4387 on the consumption side. Five further live series were found among the probed IDs, each returning a constant value across a full week (14808, 4056, 9402, 15308 and 9226 MW)
why_it_cannot_serve_as_observed_dispatch: No battery category exists. Pumped hydro is a different technology with different duration and different marginal cost. The five constant series are installed capacity rather than dispatch.

what_it_publishes: Actual generation per production type, including B25 Energy storage with an Actual Aggregated discharge leg and an Actual Consumption charge leg
what_it_returned: Absent at all ten dates. DE_LU returns 16 production types and storage appears only as B10 Hydro Pumped Storage. The identical query against the IT bidding zone returns B25 from 2025-01-01 onwards
why_it_cannot_serve_as_observed_dispatch: The series is not published for Germany. The Italian control establishes that the query and the parsing are correct, so the absence is a property of the German data rather than of the request.

what_it_publishes: Marktstammdatenregister registry contents: installed capacity, installation counts, technology split, regional distribution, energy-to-power ratio
what_was_queried: Site and underlying registry checked for any charging or discharging time series
what_it_returned: Installed capacity and unit counts only. No operational feed is published or downloadable
why_it_cannot_serve_as_observed_dispatch: A registry records what is installed, not what it did in any hour. The counterfactual needs hourly charge and discharge volumes.

what_it_publishes: Carried in the v1 and v2 panels under a battery label, 15-minute, both legs
what_was_queried: Re-read and re-aggregated against the German battery capacity carried in the same panel
what_it_returned: 59.7 TWh discharged and 75.2 TWh charged over 2020-2025 at 15-minute resolution; as carried into the hourly panel, 43.0 TWh of discharge and 58.5 TWh of charging. Mean installed capacity on the same row was 9,417 MW
why_it_cannot_serve_as_observed_dispatch: It is the pumped hydro fleet, not the battery fleet. German grid-scale battery capacity over the same years runs 450 MW to 2,400 MW, so a 9.4 GW fleet moving 43 TWh cannot be it. Removed from the panel; the capacity column now carries the MaStR-derived battery figure, mean 1,358 MW.
